name: zoto-cursor-top
description: Live updating htop-style CLI that shows all agents across every Cursor process on this machine, with expandable parent-to-subagent hierarchy and scrolling log lines. After install, run /zoto-cursor-top-init once to build the CLI and put cursor-top on PATH.
